hooks.name: Privacy guard: block personal/secret staged files
hooks.description: Manually triggered before committing. Fails if any personal health export or secret file is staged: export.zip, export.xml, anything under apple_health_export/, data/daily.json, data/daily.js, or .env (also catches data/insights.json/.js). Exits non-zero with the offending paths and how to unstage them. Checks the git index, not the working tree.

action.command:
staged="$(git diff --cached --name-only)"; blocked=""; while IFS= read -r f; do [ -z "$f" ] && continue; case "$f" in export.zip|export.xml|data/daily.json|data/daily.js|data/insights.json|data/insights.js|.env) blocked="$blocked  $f
";; apple_health_export/*) blocked="$blocked  $f
";; esac; done <<EOF
$staged
EOF
if [ -n "$blocked" ]; then printf "BLOCKED: personal/secret files are staged and must never be committed:
"; printf "$blocked"; printf "Unstage them with: git restore --staged <file>
"; exit 1; fi; echo "Privacy guard: no personal/secret files staged. OK."; exit 0
